title: Nvidia dismisses "circular financing", says every $1 it invests brings back $100
summary: Nvidia is defending itself against accusations of 'circular financing' by claiming that every $1 it invests generates $100 in returns, yet the stock price continues to decline, raising questions about market sentiment and investor confidence in the company's financial practices.
problem_solved: Addresses investor confusion about why Nvidia's strong investment returns (100:1 ROI) aren't reflected in its stock price performance.
why_valuable: Provides insight into the disconnect between Nvidia's financial metrics and market valuation, helping investors understand potential market concerns beyond raw numbers.
